body.name: profile-recentered observed-moment inversion
body.construction: For \(\vartheta\in\overline\Theta_N(s_N)\), let \(g(\vartheta)\) stack, for each cohort \(c\), \(p_c\), \(p_c\Gamma_{S_c}m_c\), and \(p_c\operatorname{vech}[\Gamma_{S_c}(H_c+m_cm_c^{\prime})\Gamma_{S_c}^{\prime}+\sigma_c^2I]\). Compute \(d_N=\min_{\vartheta\in\overline\Theta_N(s_N)}\|g(\vartheta)-\widehat\theta\|_{\mathsf m}\), retain \(\mathcal C_N=\{\vartheta\in\overline\Theta_N(s_N):\|g(\vartheta)-\widehat\theta\|_{\mathsf m}\le d_N+\widehat\rho_N\}\), and return the coordinatewise smallest rectangle enclosing \(\{(\Gamma m_c)_{c=1}^C:\vartheta\in\mathcal C_N\}\). Compactness makes \(\mathcal C_N\) nonempty. Return \([-B,B]^{CT}\) only on \(\mathsf F_N=\{N<2k_\alpha\}\).
